mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO draw_count_bucket (bucket_id, user_id, amount, remain, expire_at, reason_type, ref_id, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{bucketId}, #{userId}, #{amount}, #{remain}, #{expireAt}, #{reasonType}, #{refId}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM draw_count_detail WHERE ref_id = #{refId} LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE

SELECT id, bucket_id, user_id, amount, remain, expire_at, reason_type, ref_id, create_time, update_time FROM draw_count_bucket WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND remain > 0 AND expire_at > NOW() ORDER BY expire_at ASC, id ASC FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO draw_count_detail (user_id, bucket_id, ref_id, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{userId}, #{bucketId}, #{refId}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.update: UPDATE draw_count_bucket SET remain = remain - 1, update_time = NOW() WHERE bucket_id = #{bucketId} AND remain >= 1
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(remain), 0) FROM draw_count_bucket WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND remain > 0 AND expire_at > NOW()
mapper.update: UPDATE draw_count_bucket SET remain = 0, update_time = NOW() WHERE expire_at <= NOW() AND remain > 0
